postTitle: My opinions on the whole merchandise thing
postSubject: I'm gonna be flat here.  I'm not a huge fan.  I don't hate them, but I do see a few errors that irk me a bit.  I can see why people are rioting, but there really is no need for that.  The designs seem a bit silly to me, but Scott approved and liked them, so I'm sure there must be lots of others who will also like them.  These toys were obviously marketed towards kids, and I'm sure they'll love it.  HOWEVER, I have a way to please FNaF fans who aren't pleased by these new toys.  We would all very much appreciate it (at least I would) if there were also a bunch of realistic, well-designed, true to the game figurines.  I'm not implying the other toys aren't well designed, but it would be a JOY to be able to line up extremely accurate toy representations of all our favorite FNaF characters.  They'd sell faster than amiibos are, and I'm pretty sure a while back some guy hijacked a whole truck of amiibos.  Then there will be the toys/keychains catered towards kids, then there will be the more accurate, realistic figurines for the more mature audience.  I hope this all goes by ok, and hope all of you (yes, even you) have an amazing day, week, month, year, and life.
commentSubject: Something to consider also is that these are not the only toys, in fact these are a very small portion of the toy lineup. There are a lot of toys coming out this year that will have nothing to do with the keychain designs.
